This '''Titterbug princess''' was royalty among the [[Titterbug]]s of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], she was considered as a potential bride for [[Vork (Gorph)|Vork]], the prince of a tribe of [[Gorph/Legends|Gorphs]]. Despite Vork's interest in the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Prince/Legends|princess]], his mother, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Slugga]], did not approve. On her orders, the Gorph guards cast the Titterbug princess into "[[Pit (Gorph's grotto)|the pit]]."<ref name="PL" />

==Behind the scenes==
This princess was created by writer [[Paul Dini]] for the [[Nelvana]] [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated television series. The episode "[[Princess Latara]]," which first aired on September 20, [[1986]],<ref name="A Star Wars CELibration">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> is her only appearance.
